name: Clown Applying Makeup
look: Four stacked panels on the right, with white space on the left for captions. A young man goes from white base makeup, to blue eye shadow and red lips, to a rainbow curly wig being placed on his head, to the finished clown face with a red nose.
use: Each step of a man turning himself into a clown matches a step in a bad decision or flawed argument. The captions build from a small mistake to full commitment, and the finished clown shows how foolish it all was.
slots: step 1, white base: the first questionable choice
step 4, red nose: the final foolish move
examples: "Okay, one more, that cliffhanger was wild"
"It's only 1 a.m., I can finish the season"
Starting season two at 4 a.m. before work
Buying a gym membership in January
Choosing the yearly plan to save money
